title: Pin StreakStateProvider's day-bucketing seam instead of letting streak_state_provider_test.dart depend on the host machine's timezone
why: read()/watch() call StreakReducer.reduce() without pinning the injectable `dayOf` seam that streak_reducer.dart's own doc comment says exists precisely 'so tests can pin a fixed UTC offset deterministically without depending on the host machine's timezone.' Both FakeLocalDayClock.today() and the default dayOf (DateUtils.extractLocalDate, date_utils.dart:64) resolve through DateTime.toLocal(), which reads the executing machine's TZ -- confirmed empirically inside the real flutter_tester harness: `TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati flutter test` shows DateTime.utc(2026,5,14,12).toLocal() shift a full calendar day. I could not flip any assertion in this specific file under that TZ (ran the suite 3x under the sandbox default Europe/London and once under forced Pacific/Kiritimati, all 13 tests green each time) because every fixture here sits at hour 0 or hour 12 UTC and every current day-gap still lands inside the reducer's +/-1-day grace window either way -- that is a property of today's specific fixture values, not a guarantee. The sibling unit suite (test/features/sync/domain/reducers/streak_reducer_test.dart:120-158) already tests the local-vs-UTC distinction correctly by injecting dayOf directly; this integration-level file has no such seam and inherits toLocal()'s host dependency instead. A fixture pair whose UTC-hour asymmetry straddles a day boundary differently under some real TZ (e.g. clock seeded at 23:00 UTC, event at 01:00 UTC) would confirm an actual flip -- the D17 rollover test already seeds close to a boundary and is the most likely one to trip this by accident in a future edit.
recommendation: Either give StreakStateProvider.read/watch an explicit dayOf override (mirroring the reducer's own seam) or have the test suite pin TZ=UTC explicitly (Makefile/CI env var) so pass/fail can't depend on the runner's locale.
acceptance_criteria: `TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati flutter test test/core/streak/streak_state_provider_test.dart` and the default-TZ run both stay green by construction (pinned dayOf or pinned TZ), not by coincidence of current fixture values.

corrections: One narrative claim doesn't hold up: 'the D17 rollover test already seeds close to a boundary' is inaccurate — that test (lines 206-236) seeds both the clock and its event at hour 12 UTC (noon), symmetric and far from a UTC-midnight boundary. The hour-0/hour-12 asymmetry the auditor describes belongs to other tests in the file. This is a minor overstatement in the supporting narrative, not in the cited evidence array, and does not undermine the core, independently-confirmed finding.

mergedFrom: Replace fixed-duration Future.delayed waits with deterministic stream-emission awaits in streak_state_provider_test.dart
